statement: The MessageRouter/formation-attribution interaction maps every production inbound socket dispatch to the exclusive transport_message owner while MessageRouter retains unchanged parsing, liveness, identification, PING/PONG, ACK, service response, ACK-before-handler, asynchronous handler, error, queue, reconnect, and delivery behavior when attribution is active or inactive; a deterministic source-revert control reaches the same production path and falsifies only the owner claim.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver verification with evidence subagent:<id>.

MessageRouter remains the sole owner of inbound parsing, connection liveness, identification, control messages, ACK and service delivery; formation diagnostics owns exclusive accounting. A typed transport-attribution interaction may map the existing production callback to transport_message, but it may not parse, classify, schedule, deliver, retry, reconnect, acknowledge, or reinterpret a transport outcome.

The deterministic witness must enter through MessageRouter.handleIncomingConnection and the installed socket message listener before reaching handleMessage. Calling an attribution wrapper or a copied transport decision directly is not proof.

Preserve ACK-before-handler lookup, no-handler response semantics, late response disposition, pending PING resolution, identification adoption, unknown-message warning, parse-error propagation, and existing delivery/retry/reconnect behavior. Attribution may observe these paths but never become delivery or completion authority.

An asynchronous service handler scheduled by an inbound dispatch inherits transport_message for its continuation, nested explicit owners hand off rather than overlap, and owner plus unattributed plus idle durations partition the injected-clock window exactly once.

With no active formation attribution window, the current and exact-mapping-reverted modules produce identical normalized socket, liveness, control-frame, ACK, service-response, service-handler, return, throw, and logging effects.

A module-loader control must remove the exact transport_message mapping while retaining the production incoming-socket path; it must reach and fail the named owner-duration assertion rather than fail import, setup, or transport behavior.

This Quest must not add heartbeat/lease, readiness, membership-publication, rebalancer, admin-snapshot, bootstrap, worker, simulator, calibration, report, artifact-transfer, scenario-ingestion, fix, or certification work. It must not use Docker, GCP, or live evidence.
